reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe (SHA-256 dea34892...); the candidate translation unit was recompiled with the repository -O3 -DNDEBUG flags and its object symbol compared with the body recorded for the previous source digest.
source_revision: worktree HEAD 5a3b6e40521b2159f6dce7e8ecbeafb8fe3b9b91 plus the uncommitted Qvm_ReportError correction; bound by engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp sha256 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp hashes to 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2 on 2026-10-23; both live graphs are identical to the bound artifacts, so the recorded CFG is current. The candidate was recompiled from that source; its object symbol body was compared with the body compiled from the previous source digest 655494c9... and is instruction-identical after relocation resolution, proving the Qvm_ReportError edit did not alter this function. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.

retail_function.name: Qvm_SetGlobalState
retail_function.summary: 0x004B8A10-0x004B8A19 (10 bytes), 1 basic block / 0 edges, cdecl int32_t(int32_t): `mov eax, dword [esp+4]; mov dword [0x00A965A0], eax; retn`. Stores the argument and returns the same dword.

comparison.changed_bytes: one 4-byte .data relocation addend (0x0 -> 0x4) in the store to g_a965a0

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both recover a single entry at 0x004B8A10 with one block and no edges; the live re-read matches the bound artifacts exactly (similarity 1.000). The candidate symbol igi::retail::script::Qvm_SetGlobalState(int) is the body implementing that entry, 16 bytes including alignment padding.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads the single stack argument at [esp+4] into EAX, stores it and returns it; the candidate takes std::int32_t state, stores it and returns it. cdecl, one dword argument and a dword return are preserved.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The only constant is the retail global address 0x00A965A0; the candidate binds the port-owned dword g_a965a0 for it. No arithmetic or scaling.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No calls. Retail performs exactly one dword store and returns the stored value; the candidate does the same and touches no other memory.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes four bytes at 0x00A965A0; the candidate writes std::int32_t g_a965a0 with the same value and width. No other memory is accessed.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: A single return path returns the stored dword in both; retail has no error path.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t(int32_t arg1) and Radare2 recovers cdecl with one stack argument; the candidate declares std::int32_t Qvm_SetGlobalState(std::int32_t). The 32-bit scalar and return are identical (int vs int32_t is the same type on this target).

limitations: No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address; runtime_tests and behavioral are intentionally absent and RUNTIME_TESTED/VERIFIED are not claimed.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score, and the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
The candidate object was rebuilt and hashed, but the image was not linked by this review; no linked-image or receipt claim is made.

The compiled object body differs from the body recorded for 655494c9... in exactly one relocation addend: g_a965a0 moved from .data+0x0 to .data+0x4 when g_a96598 was made volatile. The instruction sequence `mov eax,[esp+4]; mov [g_a965a0],eax; ret` and the symbol it names are unchanged.

The binary_ninja and radare2 evidence signatures bound here were re-derived from the current artifacts (int32_t(int32_t arg1) and fcn.004b8a10 (int32_t arg_4h);); the manifest previously said 'not restated'.
